body:
Triage: **`pm:on-hold`** (routing `domain:drivers` already in place — kept).

**Classification rationale.** This is a real over-matching defect (both remaining backends fold case on the `$contains` family, against the #4706 Q2 = A ruling), but the fix lands entirely inside `driver-memory` and `driver-mongodb`, and the maintainer's 2026-08-05 **#5499 investment freeze** explicitly suspends implementation work in both packages — the card itself says it is not a request to unfreeze. That is a decision already made ("not now"), so the correct state is a hold, not `pm:queue` (undispatchable under the freeze) and not `finding` (a findings round could only re-discover the same freeze every pass).

**Hold pair** — date: 2026-08-08; reason: #5499 driver-memory / driver-mongodb investment freeze (restated as a ruling in the #6518 dispatch); restart condition: the maintainer lifts or narrows the #5499 freeze — at that point re-queue together with the #6520 requirement-1 decision, since a `FILTER_TEXT_CASES` cell can only be cleared when both requirements are answered.

**Anchor verification** (objectstack `origin/main` @ `d6d1a50`): `driver-memory/src/memory-driver.ts:784-790,945` still builds `new RegExp(escapeRegex(...), 'i')` on the `$contains` family; `driver-mongodb/src/mongodb-filter.ts:532-546` still hard-codes `$options: 'i'`; `driver-memory/src/memory-matcher.ts:213-216` uses case-sensitive `String.includes` — the one-package-two-answers divergence described in the body is live.

**Dedup**: repo-scoped search finds no duplicate. #6520 is requirement 1 (`$icontains` vocabulary), objectui #6337 is the filter-UI half — both already cross-referenced in the body; distinct dispatch entries.

**Not `target:v17`**: both packages are under the #5499 freeze — the RC shipping without this fix is the standing ruling, not an oversight.

本评论来自分诊座位 Routine（#5474 试点），不构成认领。

- The `FILTER_TEXT_CASES` DEBT cells still can only be *deleted* once #6520 (requirement 1, `$icontains` vocabulary) is answered — unchanged.

<!-- os-dev-report -->
**os-dev report — driver-mongodb half of #6682** · session `session_01VqhD3BLddBixYd6y46mM2L` · branch `claude/issue-6682-mongodb-contains-case` · draft PR #7625 (`Part of #6682`, card stays OPEN)

## Premise verified before the first edit

The four arms still folded on `origin/main` @ `744b8f5`. Confirmed by execution, not by reading: the new case-set suite run against unmodified `main` gave **5 failed / 17 passed** — exactly the five requirement-2 rows, with the emitted documents printed (`{"name":{"$regex":"acme","$options":"i"}}`). No other lane had touched them.

## What landed

`translateFieldOperators`: `$options: 'i'` removed from `$contains` / `$notContains` / `$startsWith` / `$endsWith`. `escapeRegex` untouched (comparands stay literal). `$icontains` untouched. `$notContains` needed it in **one** place — its `$not`-wrapped operator document is the only other site.

Measured and worth recording: this driver has **no second lowering**. `find`/`count`/`update`/`delete` and the aggregation `$match` (`mongodb-aggregation.ts:164`) all route through the one `translateFilter`, so unlike driver-memory there was no analytics face to align separately.

## The NEW FACT measured — enrollment is possible, and taken

The claim comment was right and the card was out of date. `$icontains` (requirement 1) is implemented here since #6520, so requirement 2 was the last open one. The pre-fix run proves it: every `$icontains` row, every literal-comparand row and **all five rejection rows** passed before the fix; only the five case rows failed. Post-fix: **22/22**. So the cell is fully answered, not half-answered.

`mongodb-filter-text-conformance.test.ts` (new, server-free) imports the marker and drives the whole case-set; the mongodb `FILTER_TEXT_CASES` DEBT row is deleted in the same PR. Gate: `38 covered cell(s), 2 in the DEBT ledger` — both remaining rows are `driver-memory`.

## Scope respected

`packages/drivers/driver-memory` **not touched** — its query path, analytics face and reference-matcher divergence remain this card's open half under the #5499 freeze. `driver-sql` / `formula` read as precedent only. No `content/docs/releases/` edit.

## One deviation, reported rather than worked around

The dispatch note said `mongodb-icontains.test.ts`'s assertions should survive untouched, and to stop and report if they did not. **One did not, and it is the expected one, not a breakage.** That file carried a pin asserting the *defect*:

```
it('does not disturb the $contains family — still `$options: i` (the open #6682 defect)')
```

labelled in-file as "pinned here as the current state so that 'fixed the family' and 'broke `$icontains`' cannot be confused for one another" — i.e. authored to go red exactly when this card lands. It is **flipped**, not deleted: it now asserts `$contains` → bare pattern and additionally that the two arms have not collapsed into one (`$icontains` → `[Aa][Cc][Mm][Ee]`), which is what the row has always guarded. **Every `$icontains` assertion in that file is unchanged and green.** Judgement call recorded here rather than made silently.

## Gates

| gate | result |
|:--|:--|
| `check-driver-conformance` | OK — 38 covered, 2 DEBT, 0 exempt |
| `check-driver-conformance --self-test` | OK |
| driver-mongodb suite | 325 passed, 143 skipped (5 files skipped — real-mongod, opt-in) |
| spec text-conformance + operator-vocabulary | 36 passed |
| `tsc --noEmit` (driver-mongodb, spec) | clean |
| build (spec, driver-mongodb) | clean |

`mongodb-memory-server` is not downloadable here (proxy 403), so the real-mongod suites were **not** executed — they are skipIf-gated and skip on `main` too. All verification is at the `translateFilter` translation layer. No attempt was made to install mongod.

Changeset: `.changeset/mongodb-contains-case-sensitive.md`, **patch** for `@objectstack/driver-mongodb` (user-visible row-set change), pointing users who relied on the fold at `$icontains`.

CI convergence, ready-flip and landing are the PM's — not polled here.
